name: skraft
description: skraft SDLC pipeline — agents, skills and hooks for outside-in TDD, Clean Architecture and the RESEARCH→DESIGN→DISTILL→DELIVER engineering pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic agentic SDLC pipeline with adversarial reviewers and fail-closed guardrails.
interface.longDescription: skraft turns a coding assistant into a disciplined software production line. Each engineering phase (RESEARCH → DESIGN → DISTILL → DELIVER) is driven by a specialized agent, reviewed by a dedicated adversarial reviewer, and locked down by deterministic guardrails that block any out-of-sequence dispatch, any mandatory skill left unloaded, and any progression without a real artifact, an APPROVED verdict and a verified git commit.
